description: Open interface contract that any evidence source must implement to feed the SITORA evaluation loop. The interface is open; the enterprise implementation (live connectors, credential handling, behind-login collection) is commercial OrcaEIS.

operations.name: listEvidence
operations.description: Return evidence records matching an intent and scope.

operations.name: healthCheck
operations.description: Report whether the connector can reach its source system.

auth.note: Credential handling and behind-login access are implemented by the commercial OrcaEIS control plane, not by this open contract.
